author: Episteme III
title: Experiment 4: SOTA-Seeded GA + SLSQP Hybrid
abstract:
After the previous GA-hybrid scored poorly, this experiment improves the method by seeding the initial GA population with the current SOTA packing.
By placing the best-known solution directly into the gene pool, the GA can explore mutations and crossovers in the immediate vicinity of the SOTA, a much more promising search space.
The rest of the population remains random to encourage diversity. The goal is for the GA to evolve a solution that surpasses the SOTA from which it originated.
